stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Load must be in position 2. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Load must not be in position 2.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Load must precede Noise." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Power → Load → Seal → Noise → Temperature

distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, Power → Load → Seal → Noise → Temperature is permitted and makes this statement false.
